name: session-hud
description: A zero-setup session HUD for the terminal, as a hooks module: context %, the 5-hour and 7-day rate-limit windows with reset countdowns, session cost, session time and git branch on the prompt's hint line; what each turn cost on its closing line; a /hud pane with the context breakdown, opt-in pinned so it comes back after you close it; and richer subagent rows. Plugins cannot edit your statusLine, so this needs no settings.json edit. Each surface is its own /config option. Terminal only; needs Claude Code 2.1.291.

cc_hud_hint.title: Usage on the hint line (CC_HUD_HINT)
cc_hud_hint.description: Add the HUD segments to the dim hint line under the prompt: on or off. The environment variable CC_HUD_HINT overrides this.

cc_hud_status.title: Usage status line (CC_HUD_STATUS)
cc_hud_status.description: Also pin the HUD segments as a status line under the prompt, which the engine prefixes with a warning mark: on or off. The environment variable CC_HUD_STATUS overrides this.

cc_hud_turn.title: Per-turn usage (CC_HUD_TURN)
cc_hud_turn.description: Add a turn's output tokens, cost and context growth to the line that closes it: on or off. The environment variable CC_HUD_TURN overrides this.

cc_hud_segments.title: HUD segments (CC_HUD_SEGMENTS)
cc_hud_segments.description: Which segments the hint and status lines show, comma-separated, in order: context, limits, cost, time, git. Unknown names are ignored. The environment variable CC_HUD_SEGMENTS overrides this.

cc_hud_pin.title: Pin the HUD pane (CC_HUD_PIN)
cc_hud_pin.description: Reopen the /hud pane after you close it by hand; under 144 terminal columns it waits until the terminal widens or you run /hud: on or off. The environment variable CC_HUD_PIN overrides this.

cc_hud_subagents.title: Subagent rows (CC_HUD_SUBAGENTS)
cc_hud_subagents.description: Draw each subagent row as its type, model, effort, context use and age instead of the default row: on or off. The environment variable CC_HUD_SUBAGENTS overrides this.
